source: BSC (56) J7 raybot buy events of 3 armed wallets and their receipts, read 2026-09-27 from bsc-dataseed1.defibit.io (research RPC). Receipts trimmed to status/from/to/logs(address,topics,data), values unchanged. Every transaction is sent by a relayer through contract 0xccc88a9d...; the wallet named in the event id receives the coin. quote_asset_buy_events: 0xLingard's 4 newest J7 buys; the newest names BSC USDC (0x8ac76a51) as its coin: a swap INTO the quote stablecoin sent through an ERC-4337 bundler (tx 0x4337002c -> 0x4337084d), in which the wallet SENDS its coin. Not a coin buy, not identity evidence either way.
